module: Data module for genericGauges: feeds a navigation map in the HTML page. At setup it asks ui_uiNavi (game engine) to initialize the dashboard map; at each update it sends the vehicle's position (x, y) and orientation (degrees) via streamJS("updateMap").
notes: setupGaugeData receives as its second argument the HTML texture provided by genericGauges; it is required.
moduleData is not filled: the data goes directly into the updateMap stream {x, y, rotation}.

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: no property is read.

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
